_comment: Jewelcrafting Bench recipes. Tier-unlocked rings, necklaces, pendants, and charms crafted from precious bones, claws, and essences.

recipes.name: Bone Necklace
recipes.description: Strung monster bones threaded with a resilient bowstring into a protective talisman.

recipes.name: Wolf Claw Ring
recipes.description: Carve and bind beast claws and bone into a ring of endurance.

recipes.name: Venom Charm
recipes.description: Stabilize spider venom within an intricate silk weave to craft a protective ward.

recipes.name: Voidforged Pendant
recipes.description: Suspend concentrated void essence within an intricate bone weave to project a defensive ward.

recipes.name: Voidforged Band
recipes.description: Infuse a beast-claw and steel band with void essence to reinforce physical endurance.

recipes.name: Voidforged Relic
recipes.description: Encase a legendary void core in woven subterranean silk, anchoring massive extra carry capacity and health.

recipes.name: Frost Pendant
recipes.description: String a protective glacial crystal pendant onto carved bone beads.

recipes.name: Frost Ring
recipes.description: Craft a gleaming finger band from polished wolf claws and glacial essence.

recipes.name: Glacial Heart Relic
recipes.description: Anchor the Sovereign's glacial core into a wondrous accessory granting massive health and carry capacity.

recipes.name: Sovereign's Signet
recipes.description: Set the legendary Eye of the Sovereign into an ornate signet ring of extraordinary durability.

recipes.name: Magmaheart Pendant
recipes.description: A glowing volcanic talisman thrumming with the geothermal pulse of the caldera.

recipes.name: Heart of Winter
recipes.description: The legendary crystalline signet enclosing the living eye and sovereign heart of winter.

recipes.name: Apprentice's Focus Ring
recipes.description: Carve and bind beast claws and bone into a ring that channels fledgling spellcasting energy.

recipes.name: Void Focus Pendant
recipes.description: Suspend planar void essence within an intricate bone weave to accelerate caster energy regeneration.

recipes.name: Frost Focus Ring
recipes.description: Craft a gleaming finger band chilled with glacial essence to expand energy reserves.

recipes.name: Frost Spellcharm
recipes.description: Anchor the Sovereign's glacial core into a wondrous charm granting spell damage and rapid energy recovery.
